entries.question: An engineer must explain an individual ACR container image’s internal composition and how stored layer content is reused across images. Which two statements directly address those representation topics? Select two.
correctAnswerText: A manifest lists an image’s layers and configuration.
Images can share identical content-addressed layers.

entries.question: A single-revision Container Apps worker uses an Event Hubs scaler and one consumer group over four partitions. Four replicas are already processing all four partitions, one assigned consumer per partition, but lag grows. The partition count and consumer group must remain unchanged. An operator proposes scale-setting changes to add useful simultaneous partition readers. Which response fits these conditions?
correctAnswerText: Treat useful reader concurrency as capped at four for this consumer group.
entries.subskill: Implement event-driven scaling by using Kubernetes Event‑driven Autoscaling (KEDA) in Container Apps

entries.question: An AKS Service in namespace ai-workloads selects app=text-service. Its intended Ready Pods are also in ai-workloads and have app=text-api; no Pod in that namespace has the selected label. The Service resolves in DNS but its EndpointSlices have no backing Pod addresses. Ports are correct, and the Deployment labels must remain unchanged. Which focused repair and validation fit?
correctAnswerText: Set the Service selector to app=text-api, inspect EndpointSlices and send a request through the Service.
entries.subskill: Monitor and troubleshoot solutions on AKS and Container Apps by inspecting logs, events, and end-to-end connectivity
